alias: Master Bedroom Climate Alert - Show on Echo
description: When the humidity or air quality alert notifies Cameron and Paget about the master bedroom (they stamp input_datetime.bedroom_humidity_alert_last_sent / bedroom_air_quality_alert_last_sent), open the Climate page on the bedroom Echo for a minute. Skipped while the room is dark (binary_sensor.bedroom_dark) so it never lights up a sleeping room. Kept separate so the two alert automations stay as they are. Added 2026-11-08.
